params.prompt:
Edit this photo. Keep the same photo: the same camera position, lens, framing and angle; the same whitewashed Greek-island wall with a deep-blue painted window frame and open blue window wings at both sides, the dark shop interior with small ceiling lights behind (no people inside it); the same young man in his early twenties with a blond top-knot, a plain navy T-shirt, navy cargo shorts and bare feet; the same white faceless mannequin on a round grey base wearing an olive linen shirt and a grey-green fringed scarf; the same young woman in her early twenties with dark curly hair, a white shirt and patterned trousers at the right edge; the same orange tabby cat sitting in the window and the same tabby cat walking at their feet; bright Mediterranean sunlight; everyone at the same size and place in the frame, unless the change below says otherwise. The T-shirt, the shirts and the scarf are plain with no print, label or logo; there is no shop sign or lettering anywhere.
CHANGE ONLY THIS: the man is gone; where he stood there is only the blue window frame, the white wall and the pavement. The mannequin stays on its round base in the same place, both feet on the base, with BOTH arms now hanging straight down; it is half-dressed: the olive linen shirt is on its arm at the left side of the picture and on its shoulders, but the shirt's other sleeve hangs empty and open at the right side of the picture. The woman stays at the right but steps in closer, so her whole upper body and both hands are in the picture, standing beside the mannequin in profile, facing it: with both hands she holds that empty sleeve open and slides it onto the mannequin's arm at the right side of the picture. The grey-green fringed scarf hangs over her own shoulder, waiting to go on next. She looks at the sleeve. The orange cat stays in the window and the tabby cat stays on the pavement; both look at her. Must NOT appear: the man, a second woman, a second mannequin, a raised waving hand, a fully dressed mannequin, a dress form, the mannequin lifted off its base or tilted, someone carrying the mannequin, a mannequin behind glass.
Look: a real UGC snapshot taken on a phone in bright direct sunlight, real skin texture, one fine grain over the whole image, natural colours, 9:16. Real physics: everyone stands with visible contact with the ground, nothing floats.
Strictly no text, letters, digits, numbers, signs, logos or brand names anywhere, also none on clothes, objects or vehicles. Correct hands with five fingers, each hand holding only what is named; correct arms, legs and paws; no extra limbs. No duplicated people or animals, no split frame, no collage, no mirrored copy, nothing floating unless named above; every person and animal stands, sits or swims with visible contact. Every person is fictional, not resembling any real person, celebrity or public figure. No plastic AI look, no gore, nothing gross, nothing scary.
